# fw self-install

> Reference of the fw self-install command: Install fw binary into ~/.local/bin with SHA-256 verification. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/self-install/

Install fw binary into ~/.local/bin with SHA-256 verification

## Usage

```bash
fw self-install [--dir <bin_dir>]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<bin_dir>` |
